title: Steam Settings · Storage and Add a new Steam library folder
platform: Steam desktop client · annotated 2023 Storage walkthrough
credit: rawWwRrr · original Steam Community screenshot walkthrough; Steam UI © Valve
note: Original author’s annotated screenshot sequence shows Steam → Settings → Storage and adding a library location. The final file picker is WINDOWS; on AlmaLinux use the Linux folder picker and your mounted Linux path, never copy C:, G:, or other example drive letters. Current clients may use a drive dropdown with Add Drive instead of +. Use this for Steam Storage controls only; do not treat the source’s Windows explorer panel as AlmaLinux Files.
